frontendExtra.choose_a_library_from_search_or_list_res: Choose a Library from search or list results

frontendExtra.run_a_request_to_retrieve_real_published: Run a request to retrieve real published Library data using your API account’s allowance. Search or list records first to find a Library’s complete entity reference.
frontendExtra.successful_requests_consume_your_api_acc: Successful requests consume your API account’s shared request and response-data allowance. Errors do not consume monthly allowance.
frontendExtra.choose_an_endpoint_to_configure_a_reques: Choose an endpoint to configure a request.
frontendExtra.these_requests_use_your_api_allowance: These requests use your API allowance
frontendExtra.run_request_and_read_this_record_each_se: “Run request” and “Read this record” each send a request. Opening this page does not use any allowance. Errors do not consume monthly allowance.
frontendExtra.you_can_turn_this_warning_back_on_in_set: You can turn this warning back on in Settings → Notifications → Prompts.
frontendExtra.explore_the_request_reference_for_free_t: Explore the request reference for free. To use the playground or connect an application, subscribe to API Access and create a key. If you belong to an organisation, ask an Organiser to activate your shared access.
frontendExtra.playground_requests_use_your_organisatio: Playground requests use your organisation’s shared API allowance.
frontendExtra.a_moderator_checks_the_connection_before: A moderator checks the connection before it syncs. They see whether the test passed, never the details themselves.
frontendExtra.your_current_details_keep_working_until_: Your current details keep working until a moderator approves the new ones.
frontendExtra.libraries_global_hasn_t_launched_yet_thi: Libraries Global hasn’t launched yet. This is a working draft: it hasn’t been published as terms governing public use of the service, and nobody has been asked to accept it. The final text will be published as version 1.0, with its effective date, before the service opens.

frontendExtra.this_document_has_no_content_yet: This document has no content yet.
frontendExtra.we_announce_material_changes_in_the_jour: We announce material changes in the journal and by email to account holders at least 30 days before they apply.
frontendExtra.ask_in_the_community_forum_or_write_to_t: Ask in the community forum, or write to the maintainers. We reply within 5 working days.
